_readme: Display-name overrides for lender pages, applied on top of `displayName` in data/lender-profiles.json and keyed by slug. Two separate problems live here, kept apart on purpose. `overrides` repairs capitalization that the upstream title-casing destroyed: these restore the casing of the lender's own legal name and assert no new fact, so they are safe to apply. `unresolved` records names this project cannot fix from the data it holds, either because the filer registered a truncated name or because the legal entity is not the consumer brand. Those need a sourced decision from Bill before they are filled in; until then the page falls back to the legal name, which is accurate if not ideal for search. Never guess an entry into `overrides`.
